title: Review of c25's local-drive negative: on fresh seed 11 (kernel drive, mu 0.75, kd 0.03, 256^2, t=20000), 5 lineages swim >= 3 BL ringed and divide (c25: 0 on seed 0), so 'either divide or travel, not both' does not hold as a property of the drive
summary: I ran c28's ringtrack.py and lineage_report.py on the world with drive=kernel, mu=0.75 at the default kd 0.03 (c25's setting) on new seed 11, plus labkit packs. The population is the same kind as c25's: 162 persistent splits, max generation 5, 4 merges, ring >= 1.5 in 88.3% of scored cell-frames (median 1.60), 73 tracks >= 3 BL, 72 of them ringed. But 5 lineages meet c25's own criterion (swim >= 3 BL, ring >= 1.5 in >= half the scored frames, divide): #108 swims 6.2 BL and splits into #386 and #387 (img/strip_kd03_s11_108.png, img/div_kd03_s11_108.png), and #1555, #1299, #1354 and #43 swim 3.1-3.7 BL. labkit on seed 11: L rim/core 1.37 (213/469 individually membrane-like), 105 persistent splits, merge/split 0.045. The kernel-driven cells are smaller and weaker-ringed than under the label drive (the ring is unscored in about half of the frames, and labkit's aggregate is below 1.5), but they can travel and divide.

observations.M: data/rtk_m075_kd03_s11.report.txt: 73 tracks >= 3 BL and 5 swim-ring-divide lineages under the kernel drive at kd 0.03; img/strip_kd03_s11_108.png #108 6.2 BL then splits

seeds_run.result: fail for the finding: at mu 0.75, kd 0.03 the population matches (162 persistent splits, gen 5, 4 merges, 73 swimmers), but 5 lineages swim >= 3 BL ringed and divide, where the finding reports 0
same seed at kd 0.08 (c25's correction): 125 persistent splits, 0 merges, 85 swimmers, also 5 swim-and-divide lineages, so kd does not separate the outcomes on this seed

controls_run.M: data/rtk_m075_kd08_s11.report.txt and pack_kd08/: kd 0.08 at the same seed, grid and duration

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per kd. Swim-and-divide lineages are rare under either drive (0-9 per run), so a count of 0 on one seed is within seed-to-seed noise and needs several seeds before it supports 'not both'. The kernel-drive ring is scored in only about 45% of each lineage's frames (small cells are unscored), labkit's aggregate L rim/core is 1.37-1.42, below the B gate, and tracker 'deaths' (1424) are mostly identity breaks. The label drive still gives larger, better-ringed swimmers; the difference is in degree, not in kind.
